title: Practice: Adaptive Layout and Size Classes
prompt: Write a Swift snippet for “Adaptive Layout and Size Classes” and include the required source evidence: let lessonFocus, print(. Then compile/run it locally and check one edge case.
objective: Apply the ideas from Adaptive Layout and Size Classes in a small learning task.
acceptance_criteria: Apply the rule for layout adaptation to different screens.
Include the required minimum evidence in the submitted answer.
Explain or locally verify the result and one edge case.
hints: Begin with layout adaptation to different screens; avoid writing the entire feature at once.
Use the expected result to decide what to inspect next.
A correct source-string check is only a minimum criterion; still compile and test the example locally.
grading_method: Server-side supported source-string or choice grader for the basic check; this is not a sandboxed Swift compiler. Compile and run locally for actual correctness.
retry_policy: Allow retries. Incorrect submissions award no XP; the backend remains responsible for one-time reward idempotency.
status_note: The reference answer stays in the protected content repository; public exercise endpoints must not return solution files.
